title: FW↔BACK-001: Device–Cloud MQTT Telemetry + OTA Desired-State
description: Firmware publishes sensor telemetry and OTA model/firmware status to the Backend desired-state control plane over MQTT; Backend issues desired-model-version commands. Grounded in FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.7 and §6.4 (OTA Model Status Reporting). NOTE: the sensor payload field set is NOT enumerated here — AgriSpectra is a spectral crop-disease product, not a water-quality product; the authoritative per-field telemetry schema (units, sampling rates) is owned by DATA via the Git-based schema registry (see FW↔DATA schema-change process). This contract fixes the message envelope and OTA-status surface only.

message_type.description: Discriminates the three message kinds carried over this contract. TELEMETRY and OTA_STATUS flow device→cloud; DESIRED_STATE_COMMAND flows cloud→device.

device_id.description: AgriSpectra device identifier per Backend provisioning convention (e.g., AG-000142).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the reading or state transition.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the device telemetry schema, incremented by FW in the telemetry header and validated by DATA at ingest.

active_model_version.description: Currently ACTIVE inference model version; reported in every telemetry heartbeat so Backend can reconcile fleet-wide model distribution against desired state.

payload.description: Sensor reading object. Field-level structure (field names, types, units, ranges) is defined by the authoritative DATA telemetry schema registry, not by this contract. Validators MUST resolve payload against the schema_version-pinned DATA schema.

ota_status.description: OTA model/firmware artifact status report (message_type = OTA_STATUS), per the OTA Model Artifact Contract.

model_version.description: Model version the status refers to.

current_state.description: Current OTA state. Firmware reports each transition to the Backend desired-state control plane.

failure_code.description: Failure/rollback reason code; NONE when state is healthy.

desired_state_command.description: Backend→device command (message_type = DESIRED_STATE_COMMAND). Firmware acknowledges within 5 seconds of receipt.

desired_model_version.description: Model version Backend wants the device to run.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Touches the OTA strategy / device-cloud control plane (platform/protocol/OTA — permanent HITL gate). Routine telemetry shape clarifications within the rubric are Tier-3; any change to OTA state machine, signing, or desired-state semantics is Tier-1.
x-macp.cadence: CONTINUOUS (telemetry); SLA_FROM_EVENT (OTA status reported within 1 min of download completion, ROLLED_BACK within 30 s, desired-state ACK within 5 s)
confirm_conditions: message_type, device_id, timestamp, schema_version all present and valid
schema_version resolves to a registered version in the DATA telemetry schema registry
for TELEMETRY: payload validates against the pinned DATA schema; active_model_version present
for OTA_STATUS: current_state is a valid enum and any non-healthy state carries a failure_code
device_id matches an enrolled device in the Backend fleet registry
reject_conditions: OTA state transition is illegal (e.g., DOWNLOADING→ACTIVE skipping VERIFIED/APPLYING)
failure_code = UNKNOWN_VERSION returned for a desired_state_command (Backend must reconcile)
counter_conditions: schema_version is newer than the consumer's known set but within the active transition window — request the registry pointer before accepting
payload field appears whose unit/range is ambiguous against the DATA schema — request schema-change coordination (FW↔DATA process)
